reason: the design fails 2 of its checks

findings.text: RESU-3 is not covered: SKIP-1 covers skipping already-complete stages k-1, but no SPEC has a Then asserting that stage k (the interrupted stage) emits a stage.start event or is dispatched. Skipping k-1 does not logically guarantee k is dispatched. — "which runs again from its start" [FIX IN DESIGN: add or widen a SPEC so it covers this]

RESU-4 is not covered: RHYD-1 covers outputs present and no dispatch of 1…k-1; SKIP-1 covers the skip of k-1; but no SPEC has a Then asserting stage k emits stage.start. The requirement's last clause has no SPEC that affirmatively tests it. — "and stage k is dispatched" [FIX IN DESIGN: add or widen a SPEC so it covers this]
